notes:
Summary: Mid-market SaaS (B2B product discovery) evaluating Redwood for a reranking pipeline. Initial interest in Hosted API for quick integration, then Dedicated for predictable throughput and data isolation once we prove lift.

Context / problem: Search quality for enterprise customers is inconsistent — baseline is Elasticsearch BM25 + SBERT embeddings for recall; top results often irrelevant. Product team wants to push a learned reranker to improve top-3 precision for recommendations and search. Current manual tuning is expensive; need reproducible offline evals.

POC ask: Redwood rerank endpoint that accepts candidate id list + context and returns re-scored ordering. Offline scoring pipeline to run across 10k eval queries (labelled/heuristic) and produce NDCG/MRR deltas vs baseline. Must support batch offline scoring and an online low-latency path for serving.

Performance targets:
- Online latency target: 50ms p95 for reranker call (tight path), 120ms max acceptable for peak spikes.
- Throughput target: steady 20-30 qps during business hours, burst to 80 qps for campaigns.
- Cost sensitivity: mid. Want clear unit economics and a projected cost per 1M rerank requests.

Security/compliance: Company requires SSO (SAML) for console access, audit logging for inference requests, KMS for key management. Data residency: prefers na but can accept multi-region with controls.

Recent conversations (bullets / CRM style):
- 2024-09-15: Initial inbound contact via website (Jordan). Low-level interest in Hosted API (discovery).
- 2024-10-01: Demo (hosted_api) with Jordan + Aisha present. Walked through streaming + rerank API. They asked about preserving candidate ids and response mapping.
- 2024-10-12: Technical deep-dive (ff_2024-10-12_ef23b9): SE Aisha, engineering leads (eng_lead@nimble). Discussed eval set format, offline scoring throughput, sample CSV schema. Action: Redwood to provide scoring script template.
- 2024-10-29: Pricing & architecture call (ff_2024-10-29_7a6c1d). Product lead quote: "Top-3 precision directly ties to conversions — we'll pay for measurable lift." Discussed Dedicated trial (3 months) vs Hosted steady-state costs.
- 2024-11-02: Provided sample eval-set and preliminary cost estimate. Requested Dedicated trial pricing with 50% committed utilization.

Technical details / POC plan (shorthand):
- Candidate generation: Elastic + SBERT recall (existing).
- Reranker: Redwood-hosted endpoint during POC -> score top-50 candidates, return top-10.
- Offline scoring: run 10k queries through candidate generator -> reranker -> compute NDCG@10, MRR. Compare to baseline engine.
- Eval set: need 10k queries, ~30k relevance labels (mix of implicit signals + small manual annotation). They shared drive://nimble-rankcraft/eval-set/sample-queries.csv.
- Fallback plan: smaller quantized model or cached prefix for hot queries. Must support model variant routing (hosted fallback).

Commercial / pricing notes:
- They prefer to start with hosted to validate lift (lower friction). If NDCG uplift > 7% and latency targets met, they'll move to Dedicated for predictable cost.
- Estimated ARR range provided in review: 50k-150k. Budget owner: Head of Product (Maya Chen). Procurement cycle: Q4 approval for Jan pilot.

Open action items for Redwood:
- Share scoring script template and sample outputs (done 2024-11-02).
- Provide 3-month Dedicated trial pricing with 50% utilization SKU.
- Fill out security questionnaire (SEC-4431).
- Confirm SAML onboarding steps and expected lead times.

Sales notes / talk tracks:
- Emphasize predictable per-rerank unit economics and Dedicated cost smoothing.
- Highlight offline scoring + eval tooling (NDCG/MRR dashboards) to prove lift.
- Outline failover model (hosted fallback) to meet their SLA asks.

Quote snippets: "If we can show consistent +7% NDCG in offline evals with acceptable latency, we can justify Dedicated commitment." — Maya Chen (Head of Product).

Next steps (short): Redwood to return final trial pricing + attach scoring script; internal Nimble to budget sign-off by end of Dec.
